subject.title: fix(cli): bound approvals file read size in exec-approvals-cli

question: What maximum size should the documented approvals `set --file` import support without breaking existing persisted allowlist exports?
rationale: The source confirms a bound is useful, but neither the current CLI contract nor the docs establish that disk-backed approvals imports should share stdin’s 1 MiB ceiling.

options.title: Use a separate disk-file limit
options.body: Keep the bounded fd reader but choose and document a higher approvals-file ceiling, with compatibility coverage above 1 MiB.

options.title: Adopt a 1 MiB import contract
options.body: Keep the proposed limit and explicitly accept that existing larger approvals imports must be split or edited before use.

recommendation.title: Use a separate disk-file limit
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded fd reader but choose and document a higher approvals-file ceiling, with compatibility coverage above 1 MiB.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior shipped approval-policy work ties this person to the persisted approvals and CLI product boundary.
